_source: Counts come from 119 agent-written docs in the owner's notes repo (2026-10-09 analysis), plus the owner's DS editing guide (ai-writing-suite notes/ai-editing-guide-for-ds.md). A rule without evidence does not belong here.

D1.name: answer first
D1.evidence: 76/119 docs open with method, sources or status; 67/119 have no summary label in the first 12 lines; 9/11 plans have none
D1.note: Not applied to type 'reference' (lookup pages have no single answer).

D2.name: bold density
D2.evidence: 64/119 docs have 3 or more bold spans per 100 words (median 3.2, p90 5.4)

D3.name: bold-label bullets
D3.evidence: 69/119 docs open at least 40% of their bullets with a bold label

D4.name: all-caps emphasis
D4.evidence: 63/119 docs use 3 or more all-caps emphasis words such as NOT or ONLY

D5.name: log drift
D5.evidence: 13/119 docs (6 handovers) accumulate dated DONE lines, strikethrough and stale status lines

D6.name: same point restated
D6.evidence: 27/119 docs have two sections whose content words overlap by at least 45% (reports 10/35)

D7.name: process stands in for results
D7.evidence: 33/119 docs open with 2 or more metadata fields; 69/119 carry 'verified' badges; workflow ids and /tmp paths appear

D8.name: inline clutter
D8.evidence: 29/119 docs have 8 or more inline-code spans per 100 words; 9/119 have 3 or more ID codes per 100 words; 46/119 use 10 or more arrows

D9.name: prose in tables
D9.evidence: 19/119 docs have table cells over 25 words; two plans shipped empty template tables

D10.name: unclear reader
D10.evidence: 25/119 docs address 'you' and refer to 'the user/owner' (5/8 designs)

D11.name: thinking out loud
D11.evidence: 15/119 docs keep thinking-out-loud asides or self-praise

D12.name: length budget
D12.evidence: median 718 words, p90 1687; one audit is 78% appendix restating its body; a three-doc plan set ran to 6,882 words

D13.name: unsupported stat or causal words
D13.evidence: DS editing guide: accepting 'statistically significant', 'causal' or 'drives' unchecked is an anti-pattern because the writer may not know the test design

D14.name: hedges in the answer
D14.evidence: DS editing guide: about one hedge per claim, none in the TL;DR
